dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped geometries concentrated on the dorsal and upper-lateral surfaces, featuring high-contrast light-gray perimeters with sharp gradients against a dark-charcoal base, surrounding darker interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid high-intensity light-gray pixel clusters located primarily along the mid-lateral flank and posterior dorsal region, characterized by a lack of internal gradient or ring structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the four most prominent dorsal annuli form a non-uniform trapezoidal polygon, while the mid-lateral blobs form an elongated, nearly linear array parallel to the horizontal body axis.
